# Curve:offset

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the offset of the exponent curve.

```lua
local offset = curve:offset([offset])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

offset (integer)
